t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Orange, green, red and blue gnomes take me to the bright forest and the other 4 colours bring me to the dark forest. I should work out which forest gives me more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: The colours of the gnomes will always be the same, for example: green & pink, red & yellow, blue & purple, orange & brown. The only thing that can change with these pairs is their position on the screen. Orange, green, red, and blue will take you to a bright forest with a red basket and Pink, yellow, brown, and purple will take you to a dark forest with a yellow basket. Work out which forest gives you the most mushrooms but be aware that it can switch at any moment.Good luck! :)
